slides.title: Smart Pants — What Are You Solving
slides.body:
Problem: A correct answer can hide a misunderstanding, and learners need different ways into a lesson.
Solution: Discovery answers → reviewed profile → customized lesson → fresh understanding check.
Demo: Maya chooses examples and short steps; her lesson changes its opening, pacing and feedback.
Live URL: https://instantly-henry-reforms-notebook.trycloudflare.com/?demo=combined
Modalities: text + interactive visual math; optional device voice for Discovery prompts.
Learning outcome: check reasoning on a new unaided problem; learning gains are not yet validated.
Data: synthetic profiles and authored examples; no real student records.
Status: profile-to-lesson mapping runs; math responses are prepared. Live voice/handwriting assessment is in progress.

slides.title: Smart Pants — Why Our Team
slides.body:
Team–problem fit: We combine learner-facing product thinking with software engineering and testable reasoning rules.
Relevant experience: Yuan brings software engineering; Heather brings product marketing. We own complementary parts of one learner journey.
Built together: a reviewed profile handoff, an explainable lesson design and a working integration preview.
Next: complete live multimodal tutoring, expand lesson coverage and evaluate independent application with learners.
